items.title: Nvidia unveils AI breakthrough that goes beyond chatbots — TradingView News
items.summary:
GuruFocus
GuruFocus

# Nvidia unveils AI breakthrough that goes beyond chatbots

Nvidia Corp. (NVDA, Financials) unveiled its GR00T 2 robotics model and Isaac Lab 3.0 programming tools, advancing its attempts to apply artificial intelligence to physical devices.

The business unveiled the technique at the Conference on Robot Learning in Austin, Texas. [...] The model may also transfer taught abilities to other robot designs, without the need for being demonstrated on each machine.

Nvidia stated GR0T 2 was among the top three models on a few robotics benchmarks, including RoboCasa365 and RoboLab.

The system may interact with AI agents through an application programming interface, perhaps enabling autonomous systems to coordinate more complicated operations. [...] GR00T 2 is an open robotics world model from the Cosmos platform from Nvidia. It was trained on both robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of open-source video from a person's point of view.

The model was able to do 40 out of 50 jobs it was tested on without task-specific examples, Nvidia says.

GR00T 2 performed successfully on 50 tasks, each with a single demonstration, with a success rate of 71%. That rose to 95% after five demonstrations.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
November 9, 2026

In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge. [...] The researchers then gave the AI that simulation and their Graph-as-Policy framework. The AI generated a robot-control program and repeatedly tested and improved it in simulation. When the researchers ran the resulting code on a real robot, it worked.

Six illustrations showing a robotic claw doing various industrial tasks, including hanging items on a wall and pulling cables through different configurations.

items.title: How are we all feeling about AI right now? – Deseret News
items.summary: Fast-emerging artificial intelligence tools and software are stoking plenty of concerns as an increasing number of AI-driven misdeeds are reported. And alongside those incidents, predictions are coming from some within the AI development world that the technology could advance to the point of threatening the whole of humanity. [...] Faster medical research and new treatments; earlier, more accurate diagnosis of disease; and scientific discovery beyond health occupied the top spots for both polling samples. Both audiences also matched up in their next three AI hopefulness rankings of improving accessibility for people with disabilities; lowering the cost of goods and services; and taking over dangerous or repetitive work. [...] Johns Hopkins University professor and AI researcher Christopher Honey reviewed the new polling data and, in a Deseret News interview, said he sees a notable convergence between the Deseret News poll’s findings on artificial intelligence and what he discovered in his own national polling — people want safeguards around AI, but they also hope the technology will deliver meaningful advances.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Để tìm nguyên hàm của hàm số $f(x) = x^2$, ta áp dụng công thức tính nguyên hàm cơ bản cho hàm lũy thừa:

$$\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \quad (\text{với } n \neq -1)$$

Với $n = 2$:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Vậy nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là **$\frac{x^3}{3} + C$** (trong đó $C$ là hằng số thực).

Tôi là một trợ lý nghiên cứu thông minh và nhanh nhẹn, được trang bị các công cụ hiện đại để hỗ trợ bạn trong nhiều tác vụ khác nhau. Dưới đây là những gì tôi có thể làm cho bạn:

2. **Nghiên cứu tài liệu khoa học:** Tìm kiếm các bài báo khoa học, tra cứu nội dung học thuật từ các cơ sở dữ liệu.

4. **Xử lý nội dung:** Đọc, phân tích, tóm tắt nội dung từ các trang web hoặc tài liệu theo yêu cầu.
5. **Soạn thảo và gửi thông tin:** Giúp bạn chuẩn bị, định dạng và gửi các văn bản, báo cáo một cách nhanh chóng.

items.summary: ### Mỹ báo động cả Trung Đông, Iran sẵn sàng thay đổi học thuyết hạt nhn. items.title: AI News Today, November 9: Top Stories | AI Weekly
items.summary: Starting Nov 9, Microsoft is applying fair-use limits on additional Copilot Chat features to commercial tenants with more than 2,000 Microsoft 365 seats, after rolling them out to smaller tenants on Nov 2. The caps hit users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, affect web, desktop and mobile apps, and cover features including image generation. Microsoft has not published the numeric limits and administrators cannot view or modify them; users only learn they've hit a cap via in-product [...] Artificial Analysis shipped Decision Index v2 on Nov 8, lifting private-benchmark weight from 25% to 45% and rewarding calibrated confidence alongside accuracy. Decision models Drex Max v1.1 from Nace AI and GLiDE v1.2 from Fastino Labs tie at 73, with Base Labs' Mammoth 27B at 72; Claude Haiku 5.5 (Max) tops the LM side at 77 and GPT-6 Luna (Max) scores 76 at higher cost and latency. The new AA-Paperclip component runs 1,500 real documents (resumes, receipts, invoices, research papers) and [...] Axon is putting $1.2B into autonomous-drone maker Skydio at a $5.2B pre-money valuation, lifting its stake from roughly 15% to 37% through a mix of ~60% cash and ~40% Axon stock, with only $255M of new primary capital and the rest secondary. The deal makes Axon the exclusive distributor of Skydio drones to US and Canadian public-safety agencies, cementing a public-safety drone duopoly. Axon stock fell ~18% on the news, pressured in part by $130M of counter-drone orders slipping beyond 2026.
